conclusion: Runtime first-use asynchronous PSOs are functional. First-tour 1% Low improves, but the worst single stall increases; do not enable by default based on these results.
default: Runtime asynchronous PSO experiment remains off; PSO precaching off. Existing history/local-clock/priority-wake defaults retained.

protocol.ready: At least 600 game frames, texture streaming pending zero, then 10 seconds
protocol.instrumentation: Rare pipeline/shader API wrappers and one submit-interval record per frame. No per-bind/draw wrappers, CPU profiler, browser trace or extra GPU queries in performance runs.
protocol.browserCache: Retained browser/driver caches, fresh visible Edge session per run
protocol.metric: 1% Low is inverse mean of the slowest ceil(total frames * .01) submission intervals pooled across the two runs. Not physical display latency.
